description: Source file implementing a Confluence API client with methods to fetch resources, spaces, space details, content, and user permissions, utilizing httpx for async HTTP calls and supporting multiple authentication methods.

classes.name: ConfluenceService
classes.description: Service class for interacting with Confluence REST API, providing async methods to retrieve spaces, space details, content, and user permissions, handling multiple authentication methods.

methods.name: str _get_confluence_base_url(session: SessionInfo)
methods.description: Constructs and returns the base URL for Confluence API calls based on session authentication method and info.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _get_auth_headers(session: SessionInfo)
methods.description: Generates the appropriate HTTP headers for authentication based on session's auth method.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_accessible_resources(session: SessionInfo)
methods.description: Fetches the accessible Confluence resources for OAuth-authenticated sessions.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_spaces(session: SessionInfo, cloud_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the list of Confluence spaces accessible to the authenticated user, handling OAuth cloud IDs or API token base URLs.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_space_details( session: SessionInfo, space_key: str, cloud_id: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific Confluence space, given space key and optional cloud ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_space_content( session: SessionInfo, space_key: str, cloud_id: Optional[str] = None, content_type: str = "page" )
methods.description: Fetches content items (pages, blog posts) within a given Confluence space.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_user_permissions(session: SessionInfo, cloud_id: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches user information and permissions for the authenticated user.
